body.name: Exact-close triangular-array class \(\mathfrak M\)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M=\{\mathbf P=(\mathbb P_n)_{n\ge1}:\mathbb P_n=\bigotimes_{r\in\mathcal R}P_{r,n}^{\otimes n_r}\text{ for every }n\ge1,\text{ and there exists a full array }(P_{r,n}^{\star})_{r\in\mathcal R,n\ge1}\text{ for which ass:consistency, ass:stable-fractions, ass:uniform-fourth-moment, ass:covariance-regularity, ass:nonempty-close-set, and ass:additive-untreated-change hold}\}\).
